q: Fluorine-18 ($Z = 9$) decays by beta plus decay. Which nucleus is formed?
a: In beta plus decay a proton turns into a neutron, so $Z$ decreases by one and the mass number is conserved: ${}^{18}_{9}\text{F} \to {}^{18}_{8}\text{O} + {}^{0}_{+1}\text{e} + \nu$. Oxygen-18 is formed. Review if needed the chapter *The atomic nucleus and radioactive decay*.

q: How large is the energy of a photon of $400\,\text{nm}$ violet light in electronvolts?
a: $E = \tfrac{hc}{\lambda} \approx \tfrac{1240\,\text{eV}\,\text{nm}}{400\,\text{nm}} = 3.1\,\text{eV}$. Review if needed the chapter *The photoelectric effect and the photon*.
